_notes.absolute_path: If your client requires an absolute path, replace command with the output of `which chrome-devtools-mcp`, e.g. /usr/local/bin/chrome-devtools-mcp or /opt/homebrew/bin/chrome-devtools-mcp.
_notes.custom_port: To use a non-default port, set args to ["--port", "3001", "--chrome-url", "http://localhost:9222"].
